newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish president congratulates Ken Doherty.
newsitem.headline: Irish president congratulates Ken Doherty.

text.p: Irish president Mary Robinson congratulated Ken Doherty who became the first world snooker champion from the Republic of Ireland when he beat Scotland's Stephen Hendry by 18 frames to 12 in the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield last night.

"In winning the World Amateur Championships and in captaining the Irish team to reach the final of the Snooker World Cup you showed great personal determination, courage and skill. In winning the World Championships you combined all of these attributes with nerves of steel," Robinson said in a message to Doherty.
"As world champion, I believe you will be a great ambassador for Ireland and a fine role model for all young sport people."
